verdict.rationale: Paperspace's evidence describes VM-based 'Machines' with auto-shutdown after inactivity (docs-5) and container 'Deployments'/autoscaling-groups (docs-8, probe-rt-1), but nothing confirms true serverless GPU workers that scale to zero per-request and back up automatically without idle billing — the model described is always-provisioned instances that stop, not ephemeral serverless invocation.
